traits.name: Natural Resilience
traits.text:
A life away from the pleasures of
society has made the hunter tougher than an
ordinary individual. It has advantage on Constitution
and Strength saving throws.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hunter makes two shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one
target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) poison
damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range
30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing
damage plus 5 (2d4) poison damage.
